51551395.DESCRIPTION: Binding affinity to recombinant human wild type STING (155 to 341 residues) expressed in Escherichia coli BL21 DE3 assessed as dissociation constant by Isothermal titration calorimetry analysis

original_paragraph.Materials and Methods - Isothermal Titra: Binding affinities and the thermodynamic signature of the binding event were determined using ITC. The stock solution of wt-hSTING (155–341) (7.3 mg/mL, 310 μM) in 20 mM Tris pH 8.0, 100 mM NaCl and 2 mM DTT was buffer exchanged (NAP5 column) to analysis buffer and adjusted to a final concentration of 134 μM. The analysis buffer contained 20 mM Tris pH 7.5 and 150 mM NaCl. 300 μL of a 20 μM protein solution was applied to the measurement cell. CDN 13 was prepared as a 10 mM stock solution in 50% DMSO and applied to the syringe in analysis buffer at 200 μM concentration. Experimental data were measured by using the standard method (20 injections each 2 μL with 4 s duration and 150 s spacing, reference power: 4 μcal/s, stirring speed: 1000 rpm, feedback mode: high, filter period: 1 s) on an Auto-iTC200. ITC data were analyzed and fitted with MicroCal iTC200 Software (with Origin 7.0, MicroXCal iTC200 Analysis Software Replacement 7.20). Fitting was done with the model “one set of sites” without subtraction of reference data.
